primary_task: Analyze a dataset and build/validate a predictive model, delivering statistical insights and business recommendations with reproducible code.

requirements.name: Read, Write, Edit, Bash, Glob, Grep
requirements.evidence: "tools: Read, Write, Edit, Bash, Glob, Grep"; "Build models"; "Validate results"
requirements.basis: Manifest tools: "bash": "run shell commands on Linux x86_64 ... build, test, run CLIs and scripts", "read", "write", "edit"

requirements.name: context-manager
requirements.evidence: "When invoked:\n1. Query context manager for business problems and data availability"
requirements.basis: The manifest does not name a context manager. It grants "agent": "start sub-agents that work in parallel, send them messages and list them" and "ask_user", but lacks "connectors or integrations other than the tools listed". Would need to check whether a context-manager agent is installed.

requirements.name: python with pandas, numpy, scikit-learn, statsmodels, xgboost/lightgbm, plotly/seaborn
requirements.evidence:
"Tools & libraries:
- Pandas proficiency
- NumPy operations
- Scikit-learn
- XGBoost/LightGBM
- StatsModels
- Plotly/Seaborn"
requirements.basis: "install packages from the open registries (pip from PyPI, ...)"

requirements.name: dataset
requirements.evidence: "extract statistical insights from datasets"; "Query context manager for business problems and data availability"
requirements.basis: The manifest grants "local_filesystem" ("read files in the working directory") but says nothing about where the user's data lives; would need to check that the dataset is in the working directory or on an allow-listed host.

requirements.name: pyspark
requirements.basis: "install packages from the open registries (pip from PyPI, npm, apt from Ubuntu, ...)"

requirements.name: gpu
requirements.basis: "a GPU (no NVIDIA or other accelerator; no CUDA)"

notes: Unknown and not blocking: context manager (numbered step 1) and the dataset location. Other readings: treating the context manager as an unlisted integration gives BLOCKED on other:context-manager; if the data sits in a cloud warehouse or SaaS (needs credentials) it would be BLOCKED on the data source. 'Monitoring dashboard' in the delivery note is follow-up work. Deep-learning-heavy requests would be slow without a GPU but CPU training is possible.
